records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales generated in the three months ended September 28, 2025 increased $174.4 million, or 3.8%, from net sales generated in the three months ended September 29, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the third quarter of 2025, the U.S. chicken market experienced firm volume demand, supported by growth in the retail and foodservice channels early in the quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As excess supply began to pressure chicken pricing, cold storage inventories rose by 4.3% in August, primarily driven by increased breast meat and wing stocks.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated a consolidated operating margin of 10.1%.
